problems.text: Bifrost ran 2.3.1, four minor releases behind upstream 2.7.0.
The pin test and the component page named 2.3.1, so a moved pin fails the gate and leaves the docs wrong.
The 2.3.1 to 2.6.0 and 2.6.0 to 2.7.0 store migrations include one-way steps, and the operator chose no dump, so the component page must say there is no way back to 2.3.1, or to 2.6.0 without a dump.

goals.text: Run the current upstream Bifrost with every caller's traffic still working.
Leave an honest record of what cannot be undone.

outcomes.change: Job bifrost runs on v2.7.0 and every caller still works
